new:
// Unofficial WebKit port: preserve the native API receiver.
vAPI.getURL = (...args) => browser.runtime.getURL(...args);
reason: WebKit native API functions require their original receiver; forwarding to the real API fixes binding without synthesizing any missing capability.
Use real native tab creation events when webNavigation lacks the target event. Opener frame identity is unavailable and explicitly not invented or claimed equivalent.
Map cache/rule-change notification onto real compilation and atomic native DNR replacement, not a fake webRequest method. Only user-filter rules are bridged at this milestone.

new:
// Unofficial WebKit port: empty label attributes mean no translation.
const i18n$ = (name, ...args) => name === '' ? '' : i18n.getMessage(name, ...args);
reason: WebKit throws on an empty message name; retain empty UI labels without suppressing real translation/API errors for nonempty names.
